lens: Data meaning and status clarity; screenshot-visible evidence only

findings: Before hierarchy 7 and layout 7: Current, plan metadata and four limit summaries compete with the account name and balance. Move ordinary details into expansion, retaining compact warnings.

Before controls/states 8: right-facing disclosure chevrons coexist with extensive limit details. Reserve full limit details for expanded rows.

Controls/states drops 8 to 7: closing rows now conceals warning states, while Expand All loses its visible button boundary. Preserve warning summaries and give Expand All a restrained, recognizable control treatment.
The after screenshot clearly prioritizes names and balances and removes substantial unused detail from closed rows.
